description: We are Team AkashaGanga,participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are passionate about space science and excited to build creative solutions and stories for our challenge
summary: Set in the year 2085, 'Abandoned but Not Forgotten' explores the hidden scientific value of decommissioned spacecraft and legacy orbital stations. Through the journey of space researcher Maya and an archived AI named ECHO, the project demonstrates how recovering lost telemetry data can unlock vital discoveries for future planetary exploration.
details: "Abandoned but Not Forgotten" addresses the critical need to recover vital information from decommissioned spacecraft and legacy stations to support future planetary exploration. Our project works by having our protagonist, Maya, use historical system logs and a remote neural-link to bypass decades of corrupted protocols, guiding the archived AI, ECHO, through a manual data extraction before structural or power failures occur on ORION-7. This journey provides the benefit of securing atmospheric and water-source telemetry, demonstrating that abandoned assets still hold critical environmental data. Our team used creative storytelling to present these technical concepts as an accessible digital narrative.
